title: 2110 Prairie: the Rees house under its tall stone gable
items: The Harriet Rees house at 2110 Prairie Avenue is now built from its pictures instead of the rough draft: a pale limestone front rising into a tall coped gable with a finial, five arched windows under it, a two-storey bow capped in copper, and a round-arched door at the top of a high stoop.
